subject: Custody decision impact and next asks for deployment mode
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Monroe <alice@fintechco.com>
Cc: Bob Chen <bob.chen@fintechco.com>, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2028-06-21T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Custody decision impact and next asks for deployment mode

Hi Alice / Bob —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and the items we need to qualify which deployment mode (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC) will actually meet FinTechCo's isolation expectations:

Summary of the ask
- Primary requirement: customer data that contains regulated PII must never be accessible outside FinTechCo-controlled networks or keys.
- Secondary: audit log retention (7+ years), key rotation policy under customer KMS, and full evidence for access controls for incident investigations.
- Operational expectation: deterministic SLOs for inference latency during trading windows; burst capacity for end-of-quarter processing.

What we need from FinTechCo (concrete asks)
1) Confirmation whether "control plane residency" (control plane / config state staying inside FinTechCo VPC) is a gate — if yes, Private VPC is the most straightforward path.
2) Any mandatory certifications beyond SOC 2 (e.g., ISO 27001) that must be included in the RFP.
3) Who on your security team will own the evidence review — we assume Alice is primary but please confirm.

What Redwood can provide (shortlist)
- Dedicated: isolated GPU pools, optional VPC peering and egress restrictions; control plane and metadata may be hosted by Redwood (with limited telemetry) unless the customer requires Private.
- Private VPC: customer-managed control plane (optional), BYOK/KMS integration, network isolation, and local audit log retention under customer policy.

Attachments: I attached your security spreadsheet back with our inline notes and a rough dedicated-mode architecture diagram.

Next steps
- Bob: please confirm whether control plane residency is a hard rejection of hosted control or negotiable.
- Marissa: can you prepare a short one-pager that maps FinTechCo's security asks to: Hosted / Dedicated / Private with explicit pass/fail for each hard requirement? Aim to have that by EOD tomorrow.
- Alice: if you can drop the specific compliance gates (format: gate name + pass/fail + evidence type) into the Drive folder, we’ll map evidence items to our standard docs.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick sync if that’s easier.

— Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com | M: +1-415-555-0183

Attachments: FinTechCo_Security_Reqs_v2.pdf (annotated), redwood-dedicated-architecture.png

From: Alice Monroe <alice@fintechco.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Bob Chen <bob.chen@fintechco.com>, security@fintechco.com
Date: 2028-06-21T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Custody decision impact and next asks for deployment mode

Thanks Evelyn — useful summary. Quick clarifications: 

- Control plane residency: this is a strong preference but not a hard block if there is demonstrable cryptographic separation and customer-controlled keys for all data-at-rest and backups.
- Certifications: SOC 2 Type II is table stakes; ISO 27001 would be nice but not mandatory for the current procurement round.
- Evidence review: security@fintechco.com will own the artifact checklist; Bob will coordinate the legal review for contract language.

I’ll upload the gate matrix to the Drive by EOD today. Could you flag any items in your one-pager that require product changes (not config changes)? Those are go/no-go inputs for our timeline.

— Alice
Alice Monroe
Head of Security, FinTechCo
alice@fintechco.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Alice Monroe <alice@fintechco.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Bob Chen <bob.chen@fintechco.com>
Date: 2028-06-22T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Custody decision impact and next asks for deployment mode

Hi all — I sketched a concise mapping and flagged items that are technical work vs config: 

Quick mapping (high level)
- Hosted API: FAIL for your hard requirement unless you accept that control plane metadata and operational telemetry are managed by Redwood. We can offer strong encryption and tenant-level logical separation but not control plane residency.

- Dedicated capacity: POSSIBLE (meets most requirements) — supports isolated GPU pools, VPC peering, strict egress rules, and KMS BYOK for model payloads. Remaining gaps: backup residency (backups currently live in Redwood-managed storage unless we configure a customer-managed snapshot path) and long-term audit export (we can export to your S3 but retention automation requires a short script).

- Private VPC / On-prem: PASS — full control of control plane (optional), keys, backups, and audit retention. Implementation is heavier (onboarding window ~8–12 weeks) and requires networking coordination + infra access.

Technical items that are product changes vs config (call out)
1) Control plane residency (product change if within Redwood product roadmap; otherwise Private is the path).
2) Long-term immutable audit store with automated 7+ year retention — we currently provide exports but not a managed immutable retention policy; roadmap ticket: INF-4921.
3) Snapshot encryption under customer KMS for Dedicated: currently engineering work (ETA Q3) to add seamless encrypted snapshots to customer KMS keys.

Proposed customer-facing artifacts
- One-pager matrix (I will attach)
- Short demo of Dedicated mode with VPC peering + keys config (20 min)
- Private VPC onboarding checklist (network ranges, firewall rules, KMS ARN steps, ops playbook)

Timing & next steps
- Marissa to upload matrix and demo invite: target 2028-06-22 EOD.
- Evelyn to confirm procurement timing and whether FinTechCo requires a proof-of-concept before contract signature.
- Alice / security@fintechco.com to confirm which evidence items are blocking vs advisory.

Thanks — I’ll mark the three items above as "product" and raise with the PM team to see if we can accelerate the snapshot KMS work.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Attachments: redwood-dedicated-architecture.png

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2028-06-23T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Custody decision impact and next asks for deployment mode

Appreciate the fast turn here. Short summary and action owners (so nothing slips):

- Alice / security@fintechco.com: upload the gate matrix to the Drive and mark each gate Blocking / Advisory by EOD 2028-06-23.
- Bob: coordinate legal on whether a Private VPC appendix is required in the POA and share the timeline for contract sign-off.
- Marissa: please share the one-pager matrix and schedule the 20-minute demo for next week (opt slots: Tue/Wed morning Pacific). Also include a short section showing the current workaround for snapshot export and the INF-4921 ticket reference.
- Karthik: loop in infra PMs for any capacity or pricing impacts on Dedicated vs Private (we need a quick delta sheet).

If we can land this decision (Dedicated acceptable with temporary controls vs Private required) by 2028-06-30 we can align the procurement timeline with FinTechCo’s Q3 rollout.
